framing: Human-AI teamwork is the umbrella. AI design and human training should account for effects across the whole team, including human-human relationships.

evidence.topic: Social influence and behavioral adaptation across human-AI teams
evidence.use: Broad agenda and the connection between AI influence and human-human relationships.
First-author mixed-methods study. Participants adapted behavior to complement AI teammates. Do not imply a production deployment or universal causal finding.

Co-author contextual inquiry with professionals. Supports attention to human needs and context when adapting AI autonomy.
